On 2023/07/15, had a conversation about the zeta function: observed that partial sums of ζ(s) act like a random walk in early stages, then later resemble Cornu spirals. #zeta #Cornu-spiral

In that zeta/Cornu discussion, we modeled the random-walk part with real partial sums S(N) and Euler–Maclaurin, using Nyquist sample points s(k)=2πik/ln(N+1). Midpoint values m(k)=(s(k)+s(k+1))/2 were claimed to correspond to Cornu spiral centers. #zeta #Cornu-spiral #Nyquist

Claim from the zeta/Cornu discussion: midpoint values M(k) are symmetric to the random-walk values R(k), because successive midpoints differ in phase by π/ln(N+1) (i.e., π/2 relative to the sample spacing). The reasoning was informal and not independently verified. #zeta #Cornu-spiral #symmetry

"Harmony Hearts" is a story about five high school girls who form a school idol club and chase their dream of music, led by the determined, ambitious Mia, despite skepticism from their school administrator. Chord progression written for the Harmony Hearts song "Shine On": Verse C-G-Am-F, Chorus G-C-D-G, Bridge F-C-G-Am, Outro C-G-Am-F — an uplifting progression fitting the song's message of chasing dreams. #HarmonyHearts #songwriting

User is writing a guide/article about pet-friendly beaches in Kihei, Maui (#pet-friendly-beaches-kihei). Topics covered in order: Kalepolepo Beach Park (with Aoao O Na Loko Ia O Maui Fishpond and Monsoon Bar & Grill), Kamaole Beach Parks 1/2/3, then Wailea Beach Resort. Two more beaches remain to be written after Kamaole.
Monsoon Bar & Grill (#monsoon-bar-grill): casual restaurant with sea views, located just beside Kalepolepo Beach Park in Kihei, Maui. Menu of tandoori dishes and curries, plus packed lunches to-go.

Grand Wailea pet policy (#grand-wailea), per grandwailea.com: pets and service animals under 50 pounds welcome; $30/night nonrefundable pet fee, waived for service or therapy animals; all pets must be leashed and accompanied by a registered guest when outside the guest room; per Hawaiʻi state health code only registered service animals are allowed in restaurants.

Kamaole Beach Parks 1, 2, 3 (#kamaole-beach-parks) in Kihei, Maui are pet-friendly. Park 1 is busiest with wide golden sand and facilities; Park 2 is quieter with volleyball nets; Park 3 is smallest with rocky outcroppings good for snorkeling. A beach walk connects all three. User wants Parks 1 and 2 framed as ideal for families and pets.
